headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: A drone struck the tanker Petro Dolphin at Sohar Anchorage in Oman, inside the Gulf of Oman zone where Saudi crude is moved between ships, and a second drone hit the tanker Valthera in the strait; neither is claimed. Petro Dolphin is not known to be part of the Saudi relay, so no tripwire fired and the odds hold. Unclaimed drone hits like these don't count toward "war by Nov. 3," which needs a confirmed Iranian claim or a US strike; that stays at 55%. Iran called the US reply on reopening Hormuz "insufficient," and the Houthis hit a second Saudi airport, in Dammam.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
